svg.title: A finding with a return path
svg.desc: Target provenance design. Native artifacts remain immutable; decoded views, alignment, selection, quality annotations, exact dataset membership and recipe revisions are distinct. A computation references exact inputs and produces a new derivative. Diagrams and signals are illustrative; no end-to-end implementation, measured analysis or participant result is asserted.
